name.ja: SD三国伝 022 真 紅蓮装 曹操ガンダム・絶影
name.en: SD Sangokuden 022 True Crimson Suit Cao Cao Gundam/Zekei

description.ja: • 曹操ガンダムの新装備バージョンと専用の馬「絶影」のセット。
description.en: • A set of new equipment version of Cao Cao Gundam and special horse "Zekei".

description.ja: • 通常形態では羽の上半分部分が手前に装着、戦闘形態では上のマント背面に下の羽の上に装着されます。
description.en: • In normal form, the upper half of the wing is attached to the front, and in battle mode, it is attached to the back of the upper cloak on top of the lower wing.

description.ja: • 兜、胸鎧、肩鎧、襟部分が着脱可能、肩、胸の鎧は同三国伝シリーズとの交換が可能。
description.en: • The helmet, chest armor, shoulder armor, and collar are removable, and the shoulder and chest armor can be replaced with the same Sangokuden series.

description.ja: • 専用の武器「炎骨刃」が付属。
description.en: • A special weapon "Flame Bone Blade" is included.

description.ja: • 曹操専用の馬「絶影」に、手綱を装着し騎乗可能。
description.en: • You can ride Cao Cao's horse "Zekei" with reins attached.

description.ja: • 必殺技「大紅蓮斬」を再現するPET材付属・曹操ガンダムが宙に浮いたシーンを演出するラメ入りクリアレッドのベース付き。
description.en: • Comes with PET material to reproduce the special move "Daiguren Slash" Comes with a clear red base with glitter to create a scene where Cao Cao Gundam is floating in the air.

description.ja: 成形品×7、シール×1、取説マンガ有り、エフェクトPET素材
description.en: Molded product x 7, Seal x 1, instruction manual included, effect PET material
